title: Algorithm: Security Role Permissions Lookup
subtitle: Access Control List (ACL) Engine
description: Evaluate security authorization across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
acl = {"admin": "ALL_ACCESS", "editor": "WRITE", "viewer": "READ"}
# Stage 1: Verify admin and guest

challenges.title: Stage 1: Role Access Query
challenges.description: Look up permissions for <hlt>"admin"</hlt> and fallback for <hlt>"guest"</hlt> using <hlt>acl.get()</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
acl = {"admin": "ALL_ACCESS", "editor": "WRITE", "viewer": "READ"}
# Stage 1: Query permissions
print(acl.get("admin", "DENIED"))
print(acl.get("guest", "DENIED"))

challenges.title: Stage 2: Dynamic Role Promotion
challenges.starter_code:
acl = {"admin": "ALL_ACCESS", "editor": "WRITE", "viewer": "READ"}
# Stage 2: Role registration
acl["moderator"] = "REVIEW"
print(acl["moderator"])
